name: Pontius Pilate
summary: The governor of Judaea who questioned Jesus and found no fault in Him. Pressed by the crowd, he released Barabbas and handed Jesus over to be crucified.

key_moments.title: Finds No Fault in Jesus
key_moments.description: Pilate asked Jesus if He was the King of the Jews, and Jesus said His kingdom did not belong to this world. Pilate asked what truth is, then told the crowd he found no fault in Him.

key_moments.title: Washing His Hands
key_moments.description: Pilate offered to release Jesus or Barabbas, and the crowd chose Barabbas and cried out for Jesus to be crucified. Pilate washed his hands before them, saying he was innocent of this just man's blood, and handed Jesus over.

key_moments.title: Shows Jesus to the Crowd
key_moments.description: Pilate had Jesus whipped, and soldiers put a crown of thorns and a purple robe on Him. Pilate brought Him out and tried to release Him, but the crowd cried out that Caesar was their only king, and he gave Jesus up to be crucified.

key_moments.title: Writes the Sign on the Cross
key_moments.description: Pilate wrote a title for the cross: Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews. When the chief priests asked him to change it, he refused.

key_moments.title: Releases Jesus' Body to Joseph
key_moments.description: Pilate gave the body of Jesus to Joseph of Arimathaea for burial. When the chief priests asked for the tomb to be guarded, Pilate told them to secure it as well as they could.
